question:
The radius of the given circle = 7 cm. What is the area of the major segment? 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d537c8165b6c42e9ebe6cfdd826afc2e19aff1e4f4fb885e1d3a87109923cc86.png]
solution:
**Given:**

Radius of the circle (r) = 7 cm

Central angle = 30°

**Formula used:**

Area of a sector = (theta)/(360^circ) times pi r²

Area of triangle = (1)/(2) r² sin theta

Area of segment = Area of sector − Area of triangle

Area of major segment = Area of circle − Area of minor segment
